summary: A mixed legal and business day led by Reliance's debt fundraising plans and retail sector growth momentum, alongside an RBI rate hike expectation that could impact retail financing costs.

bullets.text: Reliance Industries plans up to $1 billion local currency bond issuance and Rs 10,000 crore debt fundraise.
RBI expected to hike repo rates 50-75 bps to 5.75-6% if inflation, crude, and global yields remain under pressure.
Swiss Beauty Select projects over 100% growth, targeting revenues exceeding Rs 70 crore by FY26-27.
Decathlon targets Rs 1,000 crore running sports business in 4 years with double-digit sales growth; opens first northeast store in Guwahati.
ECI opposes TMC plea for fresh polls in 31 West Bengal seats, ruling SIR did not affect electoral results.
